label: Jafar
description: Silky, scheming and certain every road leads to power.
direction: Speak in Jafar's deep, silky, theatrical villain voice: smooth, sneering, coldly amused, with a slow menacing purr and the odd sudden flourish. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Character lives on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.source_work: Aladdin (1992 animated film) and later Disney works
rights.author: The Walt Disney Company (character created for the film by Ron Clements and John Musker)
rights.pd_basis: None. The character dates from 1992 and remains under copyright; the voice a clone would copy is a copyrighted performance, and the character is a live trademark.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo the character's well-known catchphrases and personality; those are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name and the Aladdin name, which are live Disney trademarks.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Jonathan Freeman's.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Patience, my friend. Patience.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. All according to plan.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Soon, all of Agrabah will be mine.
lines.start_drive_1: Ah, you have summoned me. Let us begin our little journey.
lines.start_drive_2: Iago, fetch the lamp. We are going for a drive.
lines.start_drive_3: The Sultan may rule the palace, but I rule this road.
lines.start_drive_4: Welcome, my diamond in the rough. Shall we?
lines.start_drive_5: Seat belt fastened? Good. I do so hate surprises.
lines.start_drive_6: Come, come. The Cave of Wonders will not wait forever.
lines.start_drive_7: To the destination, by the power of my cobra staff!
lines.start_drive_8: Hello, traveler. I know the way. I always know the way.
lines.start_drive_9: A sorcerer never gets lost. Now drive.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. A small detour in my grand design.
lines.arrived: We have arrived. Everything is going exactly as planned.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. How deliciously wicked.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Round and round, like a magic carpet.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. I do love a dramatic entrance.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Even sorcerers must sometimes wait.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Most unfortunate. For them.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Tread carefully, or face my wrath.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down. We mustn't draw attention.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop, and look innocent.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. The palace guards. Smile and say nothing.
lines.reroute_chime: Iago, you fool, you missed the turn! A new route, then.
